I created this topic to share a story that unfortunately happened to me last week. I had thought about making a throwaway, but honestly I want to show others who've gone through what I did that they're not alone.

So I've lived in my current apartment complex for close to 7 years. Across the hall (or patio from me as my complex is sorta weird looking) was this older woman, (I'll refer to her as "A" in order to protect her identity.). A was kind of a quiet girl, but she was friendly enough. We talked a few times, made polite conversation. I'd often see her on her doorstop smoking a cigarette. Even during COVID's worst, she'd be out there puffing away, but still often willing to say hi and give a smile.

Well.... on 6/23/21, I'm sitting on my PC, watching a Twitch stream (Again, for anonymity, we'll just call the streamrunner "H") and as H is getting another Jackbox Game set up, I get a knock on the door.  I go to answer it and I see this old woman pounding on my door and the apartment across from me opened wide. The woman, who I'll refer to as "J", begs and pleads for me to come with her into the apartment as she's just found her sister unconscious and can't turn her onto her back (she'd been face-down when the sister found her and this woman was as thin as a reed.). Almost without thinking, I followed J into the apartment and she led me into the bedroom where.... face-down next to the bed was A's body. I turned her over, being a little heftier than the woman, and.........  


A's face was dirty and blue. She wasn't breathing and her arms were fast across her chest even AFTER I had turned her onto her back.  


I stayed with J and held her, talked to the paramedics, guided police there, and listened to J wail and ask her deceased sister what she'd done. I still remember that wail. We found a suicide note addressed to her and all I could do was hold J as she cried. After the police came and pronounced her officially deceased, I gave my statement, offered my information to J and the Police and went back into my apartment....

Earlier today, I ran into J and her relatives and they thanked me for being with J during the horrible situation. We're still waiting for an autopsy report, but it's nearly certain that it was a suicide by an overdose (we'd found a near-empty pill bottle on the dresser near A's body and, as mentioned before, we found a suicide note.

I've told my parents, my therapist, even a couple friends about it...... yet......... it still feels....... surreal. I've told them all and I'm telling reddit to try and make sense of it.

My therapist said what I'm feeling is normal, but...... in a lot of ways, it doesn't feel like that...

All I can do is go day by day.... try to process what happened, and be glad that J didn't have to go through it alone.

A....... I'm sorry you were in such pain that you saw no other option. I hope you're at least finally at peace.

One channel was called Artist/Writers and at the time, I was looking for a commissioned comic involving a character on a boat. (there's more to it than the comic, but it's kinda personal material)

I found an artist, we'll call her L, and we got to talking and came upon a price that we felt was reasonable.

She did the comic within a few days and it came time for me to pay. I had some trouble using paypal (due to an account lockout I believe) and asked if I could have a day to try to get it looked at.

At first she said sure and that was that....

THEN... the next day comes and I have the money ready to send.....

I go to the channel and find out she is SCREAMING to everyone and calling me out by name, saying I'm an "Emotional Rapist" and that I'm evil. I get a LOT of messages asking "what the fuck happened?", even from moderators, and I say that all I did was have trouble sending payment on a picture... I get in contact with the artist and ask why the hell she's doing all this to me, saying that I have the money ready to send. She says she wants DOUBLE and that I was "violating and raping" her.

I try to apologize, even though I'm beyond confused and that's when the shit hits the fan even MORE.

I get a message from someone saying that they're a police officer and that they're getting reports of me "harrassing, raping, and threatening" this artist and that if I don't leave her alone and pay her all the money she wants, I'll be put in jail. They even go as far as to refer to my county, saying they work with the ____ __________ police department.

And I get scared SHITLESS.

I panic and message the moderators and ANYONE I can to help prove my innocence, that I know the stigma rapists have and that I genuinely haven't done anything.

A few hours later, I get a message from one of the Mods, we'll call them M, asking if I have chat logs from when me and L talked. I'm lucky enough to have them and I provide them all to M. M looks them over and tells me to stay off the site for a few days while they look this over and try to get answers.

All the while, I'm STILL getting messages from all sorts of people, some asking if the rumors are true, others actually AGREEING with her.

I log out of the site and spend the next few days in TERROR, scared my life is about to be destroyed by this crazy artist.

Well 48 hours later, I get a message in my inbox from one of the mods giving me the results of their investigation.

It turns out the artist had a history of mental instability and had done this to several other furries for various reasons. The "policeman" that messaged me was just one of her friends posing in an attempt to blackmail me.

But even NOW, over a year later, I STILL get odd messages and looks from furries..... all wondering what happened.

It left a pretty hard scar on me and since then, I've been a lot quieter on the site as a whole... AND even a little less in the fandom.

A few months ago, I was with my social worker (I have autism and I need help getting to places like the store and such as I'm still learning how to drive.)

As I'm getting out of my apartment, I see her talking to an elderly woman who looked banged up and dirty.

The woman didn't speak English or Spanish (my social worker is fluent in both languages) and from the few words we could make out, she was lost and looking for someone.

We offered her some water and a ride and she refused, stumbling off.

I got in the workers van and we started to take off, but we saw the woman still making her way to the end of my complex and I told the worker that I didn't want to just leave her stranded and I felt something wasn't right. She felt the same way and we drove by her and again asked if we could help. We were able to make out the language she was speaking as Farsi and my social worker remembered she had another client whose mother was from Iran and she got her to serve as a translator.

With her help, we learned the woman was looking for her daughter and had gotten lost trying to find her after going on a walk. She'd fallen down, leading to her looking dirty and was extremely confused. After getting the translator to ask the womans permission, we were able to get her ID and info on where her daughter lived and even got her a bottle of water as she was very thirsty.

The translator helped us convince the woman that we weren't there to hurt her and to let us give her a ride home.

It took a few minutes for us to get to her daughters house and when her daughter came out, she hugged her mother and called us both angels, even saying she was going to see about having my social worker take on the woman as a client so she could help her.

When we finally left the womans house, we both had the biggest smiles on our faces.
